$comment: The ONE source for the docs' package catalogue (hub docs/19, gate R7). Every feature, deprecation, retirement or version bump updates this file in the same change. Fields: id (card anchor #pkg-<id>), kind (package | design | feature: a retired or shelved part of the framework that never had its own npm name), npm (null when there is no npm name), repo (GitHub URL, null until the repo exists), category, summary (one line), status (available | preview | in-development | planned | shelved | retired), phase (roadmap phase, blueprint 18 §10; null when it doesn't apply), since (the docs line in which this status started, or null), replacement (required for retired), docs (a page slug of this docs version, or null), checklist (number in the hub's 47-package master list, docs/research/2026-11-14-package-checklist.md), title (menu label and page title), laravel (the Laravel equivalent, or null), example ({ lang, code } shown on the package page as a proposal, or null), note (optional). Phases 1-3 follow blueprint §10 (agent-tools and social-login moved up to phase 2); phases 4-8 follow the master list.

packages.summary: The framework: container, config, routing, controllers, validation, ORM, migrations, logging, authorization, tenancy and the node strut command line.
packages.title: Framework

example.code:

node strut make:migration create_posts_table --seeder
node strut migrate
